formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P10-R3 — LB7 Cohort-Instability Decomposition, Matched-Stratum Composition Reweighting, Common-Support Progress×Support-Size Restriction, P7-BATCH4↔Pooled-Cohort Conditional-Choice Contrast, Method-Composition Sensitivity & Localization-Transport Audit
state_eligibility: nonempty d<=2 TS support, non-G1, phase1_lb in {6,7,8}
decomposition: report cohort-specific target/comparator eligible-state counts and matched solve deltas
construct common-support strata present with both lb7 and neighbor comparison support in P7_BATCH4 and pooled-other cohorts
re-express both cohorts under the same pooled common-support stratum weights
compare raw matched difference with common-weight difference
report stratum-distribution total-variation distance as composition shift
repeat within CFOP where support permits; ROUX and other methods descriptive if sparse

adjudication.composition_dominant: raw cohort contrast materially shrinks toward zero or changes sign after common-support common-weight re-expression
adjudication.conditional_choice_drift: same-direction cohort contrast persists under common-support common-weight re-expression
adjudication.unidentified: common support is too sparse for stable decomposition

inference_boundary: post-R2 exploratory audit; no confirmatory p-value claim
cohort is acquisition ancestry, not a randomized treatment
common-weight decomposition is descriptive standardization, not causal adjustment
